scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [12.9276764450989, 79.3225583471629] was preserved and not shifted to force a parcel hit.
The Ranipet district custodian and state public land-record/GIS routes were evidenced, but Ranipet administrative hierarchy and parcel map coverage were not resolved.
A timeout, login wall, map extent miss, zero exact-point hit, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No stable native parcel identifier, field schema, CRS response, or full parcel geometry was obtained.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
